knownEnvironmentIssues.scope: Windows DSH workspace located under a OneDrive reparse point (e.g. E:\OneDrive\ST-\TavernWeave)
knownEnvironmentIssues.symptom: SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(<workspace>) for every pwsh call in workspace-write mode
knownEnvironmentIssues.diagnosis: The bundled diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl script reports PRECONDITION/nextAction=stop: E:\OneDrive is a reparse point and the script refuses to change ACLs through it. Report: reviews/dsh-acceptance/acl-recovery/ (local evidence, not distributed).
knownEnvironmentIssues.workaround: Switch the preset session to full access (完全权限), or use a workspace on a normal local directory without a reparse-point ancestor.
